headline: Stock exchange: Milan (+1.3%) closes at a new record on hopes for Hormuz. Crude oil turns down again
summary: Milan's FTSE MIB rose 1.3% to a new record, driven by defence and tech stocks, while Wall Street also closed at record highs. Oil reversed course and closed lower after Bessent spoke of an imminent opening of the Strait.
why: Milan's Piazza Affari is Italy's main stock exchange, and its benchmark reflects Italian banks, energy and defence companies.
why_moved: Hopes of an imminent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz pushed crude lower and lifted equities, with defence stocks leading the Milan gains.
